mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.5%) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS above 450,000 million dollars) signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE<4.5% AND RSAFS>450000), or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high GDP growth and low unemployment), a surge in housing starts (HOUST above 1,300,000 units) signals potential overheating and impending policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of instances when late-cycle expansion is active and HOUST > 1300, or signal underperforms benchmark in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 105.0) signals weakening economic activity and potential recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS rising above 250,000 jobs per month) signals a rapidly tightening labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 250000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP level regime (GDPC1 above 16,500 billion dollars), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS below 440,000 million dollars) signals weakening economic momentum, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 16500 and RSAFS < 440000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
